captures.text: Pitch debrief, Brisklane (HR software). Their CMO pushed back on our pricing model: they want a fixed project fee, not a monthly retainer. Outcome: lost.
Pitch debrief, Quorvia (payments platform). Their head of security said our analytics tooling has to pass their SOC 2 vendor review before we can touch customer data. Outcome: pending.

captures.link: calendar event 'Project Lantern pitch' (attached to CRM opportunity OPP-318)
captures.text: Notes from the Project Lantern pitch. The client's security lead raised a data security concern: any tool we use on their customer data must clear a SOC 2 vendor review first.

captures.link: #new-business thread on the OPP-318 deal card
captures.text: Recap for the channel: the payments prospect is blocked on security. They will not move until our tools pass a SOC 2 review.
Pitch debrief, Tamberly (analytics SaaS). They said the retainer is too expensive and asked for a performance-based fee instead. Outcome: lost.
Pitch debrief, Velloway (logistics SaaS). They said our 12-week launch plan is too slow; they need to be live in 6 weeks. Outcome: lost.
Pitch debrief, Holbrine (CRM software). Their VP Marketing objected to the retainer model and wants per-campaign pricing. Outcome: pending.
Pitch debrief, Mossquill (developer tools). No objections raised; they liked the creative concept. Outcome: won.
